text: US stocks plunged Friday as the AI-led selloff accelerated, with both the S&P 500 and the Dow closing in correction territory. The S&P 500 fell 3.7% to 6,910.39 and the Nasdaq dropped 5.3% to 22,617.73, while the Dow lost 1.9% to 48,147.33. Nvidia fell about 14% on reports that SEC staff are examining accounting issues, chip stocks fell sharply, and hawkish Fed comments added pressure; the S&P 500 lost about 8.6% on the week, its worst since April 2025, and the Nasdaq about 10%. The TSX closed at 33,189.85, down 2.5%, led lower by technology and materials. Europe and Asia also sold off, with the STOXX 600 down 2.0%, the Nikkei down 5.1%, the Kospi down 5.2% and the Hang Seng down 1.9%.
mood: Risk-off: AI valuation fears, an Nvidia accounting probe report and hawkish Fed talk drove a sharp global selloff, with the VIX jumping to its highest close since late March.

veqt.t: S&P 500 -3.7% and in correction, Nasdaq -5.3%, Dow -1.9%; consumer staples was the only S&P sector to rise.
TSX fell 2.5% to 33,189.85, led lower by technology and materials.
Hang Seng -1.9%, Kospi -5.2% and Taiwan's TAIEX -6.2%, while India's Sensex rose 1.1%.
